preset_distribution: Normal Debug and Release bundle the pinned model and built-in prompt codes. Individual reference-recording provenance audit remains unresolved; see NOTICE.md.
variant: Fast local INT8 by default; lazily loaded original-local float projections for one bounded per-cue precision recovery. Prefill, decode, codec and tensor payloads are shared. Prefill and decode keep the KV cache in attention layout (past_key [batch,heads,head_dim,seq], past_value [batch,heads,seq,head_dim]) without the float-to-float casts and cache transposes; tensor payloads and generated frames are identical (tools/models/optimize_narration_kv.py). The install directory keeps its original name so upgrading devices replace only the two changed graphs. moss_tts_extend.onnx is the decode graph taught to take several rows with a causal mask and per-row rotary positions; the engine prefills each voice prompt prefix once and runs only a sentence's own rows through it (falls back to the full prefill when the graph is missing or fails). Both local-frame graphs also output continue_probability (the probability their random draw is compared with); the engine ends a sentence at the first frame with 1 - continue_probability >= 0.2 (see narration_jni.cpp).
